label: Security tooling
text: patterns (OWASP CRS and bad-bot rules for Nginx, Apache, Traefik, HAProxy), blacklists (daily aggregated domain blocklist), wildbox (self-hosted SIEM/SOAR/WAF platform), zion (Rust TLS reverse proxy with WAF), secure-proxy-manager, aidlp (DLP for LLM endpoints), llmproxy (security-first LLM gateway with audit log), nis2-public (NIS2 posture management), naso (breach exposure monitoring), agssh, limits, caddy-mib, fqdn-model.

ask.question: Which domain blocklist source should blacklists add or drop?
ask.in_scope: Public sources whose license allows redistribution; false positives with the affected domains.
ask.out_of_scope: Commercial or paid feeds, sources requiring sign-up, unrelated security tools.
ask.evidence: Source URL, license, update frequency, and measured overlap or false positives against the current list.
